comments.en:
This driver is developed for the Dell 1250c, Dell C1660w, Dell C1760w, Epson AcuLaser C1700, Fuji-Xerox DocuPrint CP105b, Xerox Phaser 6000B and the Xerox Phaser 6010N printers.

Images to print Resolution is limited to 600x600 dpi, and you should stay at least 50 pixels (2mm) away from the edges to avoid clipping.
